compass: TRAIN-side per-channel log|H| residuals (out/diagnosis_r1.json). Worst cells: Bottom_Box|Y (corr -0.14, n72), Top_Box|Y (0.17, n42), Rectangular_Plates|Y (0.42, n4), Top_Box|Z (0.22). Survey peaks: 150-180 Hz cluster mis-paired (158->142 -10%, 166->153 -8%, 168->180 +7%). Extended peaks 254-367 Hz match model freq <0.5% (freq is good up there; error is amplitude/shape).

specs.rationale: Bottom_Box|Y is the worst high-n residual (corr -0.14, 72 ch) AND the 150-180 Hz cluster (box-dominated Y modes) is mis-paired by up to 10%; stiffen bottom-box panels to raise/re-order those Y modes.
Same Bottom_Box|Y cell; the peak errors have BOTH signs (158->142 low, 168->180 high) so the direction is ambiguous — soften to bracket the stiffen candidate.
Top_Box|Y resid 0.69 (n42) and Top_Box|Z 0.68; soften top-box panels to move the top-box Y/Z modes toward the measured amplitudes.
Rectangular_Plates|Y is the single worst cell (resid 0.90) though low-n (4 ch); the rectangular plates carry local Y drumhead response — stiffen to shift them.
Give the bottom-box LOWER half its own stiffness theta so amplitude updating can correct the Y sub-region without moving the upper box (targets the mis-paired cluster with a shape d.o.f.).

parametric_only control: the cross-beam couples the two box halves and governs the in-plane (X/Y) global modes; a pure parametric scale is the honest baseline the shape/thickness edits must beat (true-remodel lesson: parametric controls matched every shape edit).
